paite: Josiah in vaihawm apat tung in kum giat a upa ahi; Jerusalem ah kum sawmthum-le-khat vai ahawm hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Josiah / (2 Kum 22.1,2)

paite: TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih zel a, apu David lampite azui a, taklam ah hiam, veilam ah hiam apialsan kei hi.

Kum giat avaihawm kum, naupangtak ahih lai a kipan him in apu David Pathian azong pan a; kum sawm-le-nih avaihawm kum in Judah gam leh Jerusalem a mun sangte, Asherte, milim bawltawmte, milim suntawmte ahihbei a.
heading: Josiah In Milim Biakna Adou

paite: Baal maitamte amitmuh in achimsak ua; huaite sang a sangzaw milimte aphuk a; Asherte, milim bawltawmte, milim suntawmte ahihkham vek a, akiang ua kithoih mite han tung ah athehzak hi.
Siampu guhte amaitamte uah ahal a, Judah gam leh Jerusalem ahihsiang hi.
Huchi mah bang in Manasseh, Ephraim, Simeon leh Naphtali khuate tan in ahih vek hi.
Maitamte achimsak a, Asherte, milim bawltawmte ahihkham a, Israel gam tengteng a milimte aphuk vek a, Jerusalem ah apai nawn hi.
Huan avaihawm kum sawm-le-giat kum, agam leh innte ahihsiang kum in Azaliah tapa Shaphan, kho ukpa Maaseiah, Joahaz tapa laigelhmi Joah TOUPA a Pathian inn bawlhoih ding in asawl hi.
heading: Dan Laibu Muhkhiakna / (2 Kum 22.3-20)

paite: Siampu Hilkiah kiang ah ahoh ua, kongkhak ngak Levite'n Manasseh mite, Israel khosuaksunte, Judah mi leh Benjamin mite, Jerusalem a mite kiang a kipan ana lakkhawm uh, Pathian inn a hong koih uh dangka apia uhi.
Huchi in TOUPA' inn lammi nasemte apia ua; TOUPA' inn nasem mite'n inn bawl mite leh zem mite apia uhi.
Judah kumpipate'n ahihsiat uh bawlhoihna ding in suangsekte, apehnate leh a-inkamte ding sing leina ding in khutsiamte leh inn lam mite apia uhi.

Huchi in mite'n muanhuaitak in nna asem ua; aheutu uh, nasep ngaihtuah mite, Merari tapate lak a Levi mi Jahath leh Obadiah, Kohath mi tapate lak a mi Zekariah leh Meshullamte ahi ua; Levi mi, midang ginglawm tumsiam tengteng toh;
apuak a puakthoh mite heutu leh nna chiteng sem mite sep ding ngaihtuahmi ahi uhi. Laigelhmite, heutute, kongkhak ngak mite Levi mite lak a mi ahi uh.
Huan TOUPA' inn a hong koih uh sumte asuah ualeh, siampu Hilkiah in Mosi zang a apiak TOUPA Dan Bu amukhia hi.
Huchi in Hilkiah in laigelhmi Shaphan kiang ah, "TOUPA' inn ah Dan Bu i mukheta uh," achi a. Huan Hilkiah in laibu Shaphan apia hi.
Huan Shaphan in laibu kumpipa kiang ah apaipih a, "Na sikhate'n hih ding a seh a om tengteng ahih uh.
TOUPA' inn a dangka om abungkhia ua, heutute leh nasem mite apia uh," chi in thu atun hi.
Laigelhmi Shaphan in, "Siampu Hilkiah in laibu ahon pia,” chi in kumpipa ahilh a, kumpipa ma ah asim hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa'n Dan thute azak in, apuan abotkek hi.
Kumpipa'n Hilkiah, Shaphan tapa Ahikam, Mikah tapa Abdon, laigelhmi Shaphan leh kumpipa sikha Asaiah thu apia hi.

"Kuan unla, dan thu na muhkhiak tungtang thu uah kei leh Israel leh Judah gam a mite a ding in TOUPA hon dotsak dih ua; i pi-le-pute'n hiai Dan Bu a tuang bang a TOUPA thu azuih louh ziak un i tung uah TOUPA thangpaihna ahong om mahmah ngal a," chi in.
Huchi in kumpipa'n thu apiak mite leh Hilkiah puansilh kempa Hasrah tapa Tokhat tapa Shallum zi zawlnei Huldah kiang ah ava hoh ua, huai thu ah ava houpih uhi. Amah bel Jerusalem Misneh a om ahi.
heading: Zawlnei Huldah Thudotna

paite: Huan ama'n akiang uah, TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi, "Ka kiang a nou hon sawlpa hilh unla, TOUPA'N hichi in achi:
'Ngai dih ua, hiai mun leh asung a omte tung ah thil hoih lou ka tungsak ding a, Judah kumpipa ma a kisimkhia, laibu a tuang hamsia tengteng leng;
akhut thilhih ua hon hehsakna ding ua hon lehngatsan a, milim dangte ding a gimlim ahal ziak un hiai mun tung ah ka hehna sun ahi a, daihsak ahi kei ding,' chi in.
Himahleh TOUPA thu dong ding a nou hon sawlpa Judah kumpipa kiang ah, hichibang in chi un, TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi, 'Na thuzakte tungtang thu ah,

na lungtang hihnem a a-om ziak a Pathian ma a na kiniamkhiak a, hiai mun tungtang thu leh asung a omte tungtang thu na zak a, ka ma a na kiniamkhiak a, na puan na bohkek a, ka ma a na kah ziak in ke'n leng na thu ka na ngaikhia hi.

Ngai dih, na pi leh na pute kiang ah ka hon hohsak ding a, na han ah lungmuangtak in na pai ding a, hiai mun leh asung a omte tung a ka hon tunsak ding thil hoih lou tengteng na mit in amu kei ding, chi in gen in,' achi hi. Huchi in kumpipa kiang ah thu atunta uhi.
Huchi in kumpipa'n mi asawl a, Judah gam leh Jerusalem a upa tengteng asamkhawm hi.
heading: Josiah In TOUPA Thu Mang Ding In Thukhun Abawl / (2 Kum 23.1-20)

paite: Huchi in kumpipa leh Judah mi tengteng leh Jerusalem a mi tengteng, siampu leh Levite, mipi tengteng aneu leh alian in TOUPA' inn ah ahohtou ua; TOUPA' inn a muhkhiak thukhun bu a thu tengteng abil ua zak in asim hi.

Kumpipa bel amun ah adingh a, huai laibu a tuang thukunte hihkip ding in alungtang tengteng, akha tengteng a ToUPA zui ding leh athupiakte, athu theihsakte, adan thusehte pom ding in TOUPA ma ah thu akhung uhi.
Jerusalem leh Benjamin mi tengteng huchibang a om ding in achi ua. Huan Jerusalem a mite'n Pathian, apipute uh Pathian thukhun bang in ahihta uhi.

Huchi in Josiah hi in Israel gam in ahuap tengteng a kipan thilkihhuai tengteng apaimang a, Israel gam a om tengteng TOUPA a Pathian uh nna asemsak hi. Adamsung in TOUPA apipute uh Pathian azuih uh apialsan kei uhi.
